description: This file defines a custom exception class InvalidFileTypeException used in the OpenMRS project to signal errors related to invalid file types. It extends APIException and provides multiple constructors for various use cases.

classes.name: InvalidFileTypeException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating an invalid file type error within the OpenMRS API.

methods.name: InvalidFileTypeException()
methods.description: Default constructor, generally not recommended for use; calls superclass constructor.

methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a detailed error message.

methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying an error message and a cause exception.
